name: dotnet-upgrade
description: Ready-to-use prompts for comprehensive .NET framework upgrade analysis and execution

Prompts:
- Project Classification Analysis: Identify all solution projects; classify `.NET Framework`, `.NET Core`, `.NET Standard`; analyze each `.csproj` `TargetFramework` and SDK usage.
- Dependency Compatibility Review: Review external/internal compatibility and graph-depth complexity.
- Legacy Package Detection: Identify `packages.config` projects needing `PackageReference`.
- Project Upgrade Ordering: Recommend least-to-most-dependent order; isolate class libraries before API or Azure Function migrations.
- Incremental Strategy Planning: Propose rollback-checkpointed increments; evaluate **Upgrade Assistant** or **manual upgrades**.
- Progress Tracking Setup: Generate build/test/deployment checklist.
- Target Framework Selection: Suggest `TargetFramework` (e.g., `net8.0`); update deprecated SDK/build configuration.
- Code Modernization Analysis: Modernize `WebHostBuilder` → `HostBuilder`, APIs, and libraries.
- Async Pattern Conversion: Recommend appropriate synchronous-to-async conversions.
- Package Compatibility Analysis: Analyze NuGet compatibility; suggest versions and paths for libraries lacking .NET 8 support.
- Shared Dependency Strategy: Recommend shared-dependency strategies, legacy alternatives, and Microsoft-supported namespaces.
- Transitive Dependency Review: Resolve transitive conflicts.
- Pipeline Configuration Analysis: Analyze YAML SDK pinning; update `UseDotNet@2` and `NuGetToolInstaller`.
- Build Pipeline Modernization: Generate .NET 8 snippets; validate feature branches before main.
- CI Automation Enhancement: Automate CI build/test verification.
- Build Validation Strategy: Define build/runtime checks and unit/integration tests.
- Service Integration Verification: Validate logging, telemetry, connectivity, compatibility, runtime behavior.
- Deployment Readiness Check: Recommend UAT verification scenarios.
- API Deprecation Detection: Identify deprecated APIs/removed namespaces; use `.NET Upgrade Assistant` and API Analyzer.
- API Replacement Strategy: Recommend replacements; review `Startup.cs` → `Program.cs`.
- Regression Testing Focus: Create critical endpoint/service regression plans.
- Branching Strategy Planning: Recommend rollback-safe branching and commit templates.
- PR Structure Optimization: Recommend `Upgrade to .NET [Version]` PRs and breaking-change tags.
- Code Review Guidelines: Build/test/dependency validation checklist.
- Upgrade Documentation Strategy: Document changes; automate upgrade/test release notes.
- Stakeholder Communication: Communicate versions/timelines; provide dependency-validation templates.
- Progress Tracking Systems: Create dashboard/markdown checklist templates.
- Upgrade Tool Selection: Recommend `.NET Upgrade Assistant`, `dotnet list package --outdated`, `dotnet migrate`, and `graph.json`.
- Analysis Script Generation: Generate dependency-graph scripts and Copilot prompts.
- Multi-Repository Validation: Standardize enterprise validation workflows.
- Final Solution Validation: Confirm checks pass; verify production deployment.
- Deployment Readiness Confirmation: Produce final test results/artifacts and completion checklist.
- Release Documentation: Generate framework/CI/CD release notes and upgrade summary.
